prompts: Edit the attached pink Princess Bear illustration. Critical anatomical correction: give the bear EXACTLY ONE elephant-like pink trunk which IS HIS NOSE, growing naturally from the center of his face between the eyes and just above his smiling mouth. Replace the small brown bear nose with the base of this single trunk. It should extend forward and curl gently to the viewer's right to sniff the white daisy in his normal hand. Remove ALL of the original three ribbed hose-like appendages, their chest and shoulder attachment hardware, and the appendages at his hips. No trunk may emerge from the neck, chest, hands, belly, hips or legs; there must be one continuous trunk with one free tip and no branches. Keep two normal bear arms with normal paws, two normal legs, rounded bear ears, the gold crown with purple jewel, pink fur, cream belly and muzzle, big teal eyes and happy smile. His viewer-right normal paw still holds the daisy; his viewer-left normal paw rests naturally at his side. Remove the beach ball and blue cube as they belonged to the extra trunk demonstrations. Maintain the original high-quality cute softly shaded 3D cartoon mascot style, full-body centered composition, proportions and colors. True transparent background with clean alpha edges; no black or white background, no text, no frame, no watermark. The final result must clearly read as a crowned pink bear with ONE trunk replacing his nose.

Change ONLY the background of this illustration to perfectly solid pure white (#FFFFFF), including all negative spaces between legs, around arms, under the trunk and around the daisy. Completely eliminate the checkerboard pattern. Keep the pink crowned Princess Bear exactly as shown with ONE pink trunk replacing his nose, his two normal arms and two legs, one hand holding the white daisy, and the gold crown. Preserve face, single trunk anatomy, proportions, pink and cream colors, yellow scent marks and 3D cartoon style. Full body visible with generous white margin all around, especially above the crown. No new objects, no text, no border, no drop shadow on background. A clean pure white background, absolutely no grey squares or checkerboard.
background: White; generated transparent-background requests returned opaque checkerboards, so the final selected illustration uses a plain white background.
